crossRefs.note: Jesus summoned them, and said to them, “You know that they who are recognized as rulers over the nations lord it over…
Pride only breeds quarrels, but wisdom is with people who take advice.
Do you seek great things for yourself? Don’t seek them; for, behold, I will bring evil on all flesh,’ says Yahweh; ‘but…
But Jesus summoned them, and said, “You know that the rulers of the nations lord it over them, and their great ones…
But when you are invited, go and sit in the lowest place, so that when he who invited you comes, he may tell you…
For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.”
I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be…
But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”

translations.web: He sat down, and called the twelve; and he said to them, “If any man wants to be first, he shall be last of all, and servant of all.”
translations.bsb: Sitting down, Jesus called the Twelve and said, “If anyone wants to be first, he must be the last of all and the servant of all.”
translations.kjv: And he sat down, and called the twelve, and saith unto them, If any man desire to be first, the same shall be last of all, and servant of all.
translations.asv: And he sat down, and called the twelve; and he saith unto them, If any man would be first, he shall be last of all, and servant of all.
